about.title: Two markets. One team.
paragraphs: VIKUB is an international consulting and business development hub specialising in helping Italian companies enter the markets of Belarus and the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU).

We are the official representatives of the National Agency of Investment and Privatization of the Republic of Belarus (NAIP) in Italy. This gives us direct access to government support tools, up-to-date analysis and Belarusian businesses.

Our team combines Italian and Belarusian expertise: Mario Ubaldi is a business consultant with 30 years of experience; Viktoria Gubanova is an expert in international business communication and cross-cultural relationships.
We help companies move from understanding the market to a concrete business contact and ongoing support. We work with businesses in different sectors according to their needs.
